svg.title: C10-M06-F3: Control flow and the exit(0) stub
svg.desc: Control-flow constructs - sequence, branch, loop, call/return - and the specimen's linear exit(0) sequence.
svg.text: C10-M06-F3 Control flow and the exit(0) stub
sequence -> branch(jz/jnz after cmp) -> loop(backward jmp) -> call/ret
group instructions into BASIC BLOCKS -> control-flow graph (CFG)
ELF stub (straight line): mov edi,0 ; mov eax,60 ; syscall => exit(0)
